# Round 3 schedule (generated by plan/round3/make_plan3.py; hours are estimates)

Stage 1: 32.6 job-hours. Stage 2: 30.5 job-hours. Budget per job 5.2 h of the 6 h wall.
TC2 runs two jobs at once: keep one GPU job running and use the second slot for CPU/mix jobs or the next GPU job.

**Stage 2 starts only after `python scripts/r3_select.py` has written `plan/round3/selected.json`** (it needs the stage-1 DEV runs; priority P1 jobs).

```
sbatch --export=ALL,QUEUE=<queue file> slurm/job_queue_gpu_tc2.sbatch   # gpu and mix queues
sbatch --export=ALL,QUEUE=<queue file> slurm/job_queue_cpu_tc2.sbatch   # cpu queues
```
